decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am  to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding Condition B5, before the development hereby permitted is commenced details of the toilet facilities proposed shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved detail shall be implemented before the development is brought into first use and retained.

Condition : 6 - On the basis that the last use of the site is as offices, the principle of the proposal is considered acceptable and would contribute to urban regeneration and the re-use of previously developed land.  The proposal for 56sq.m of office (B1a) floorspace is not considered to impact on on-street parking or upon the amenities of adjoining residential occupiers and, given the size and nature of the intended alterations and subject to a safeguarding provision to secure toilet facilities for disabled people, there is no objection in terms of disabled access. The proposal is therefore considered in accordance with policies IMP.1.2 (The Reuse and Recycling of Urban Land and Buildings), ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), E.1.2 (Locations for Business (B1) Use), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities), E.3.1 (Disabled Access), T.1.1 (Location of Development), T.1.2 (The Movement Implications of Development), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) and ENV-P.2.5 (Energy and Resource Efficiency) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 and Policies of the London Plan adopted February 2004 including 3C.22 (Parking Strategy).
